verdict.rationale: SigNoz has a public pricing page that says you can add unlimited teammates and monitor any number of hosts. Its llms.txt describes SigNoz Cloud's pricing as simple usage-based. That points to published, self-serve pricing that isn't tied to seats or hosts, but the pack never shows the actual per-signal rates for logs, traces or metrics, so cost prediction can't be confirmed. Missing for 10: the published per-signal rates (per GB or per million spans or samples), any cost calculator or estimator, explicit confirmation that no sales contact is needed, and independent corroboration that costs are predictable.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can predict costs from transparent published per-signal pricing without talking to sales
